<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **17** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/system.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/system.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**4** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx`  _(via submitBehavior (literal, a string literal in appTranslationDataShape; a string literal in pushFormViewCopy; a string literal in pushThankYouPanel))_
- `content/docs/ui/forms.mdx`  _(via submitBehavior (literal, a string literal in appTranslationDataShape; a string literal in pushFormViewCopy; a string literal in pushThankYouPanel))_
- `content/docs/ui/public-data-collection.mdx`  _(via submitBehavior (literal, a string literal in appTranslationDataShape; a string literal in pushFormViewCopy; a string literal in pushThankYouPanel))_
- `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx`  _(via emptyText (literal, a string literal in appTranslationDataShape), submitBehavior (literal, a string literal in appTranslationDataShape; a string literal in pushFormViewCopy; a string literal in pushThankYouPanel))_

⛔ **4** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-1.mdx`  _(via submitBehavior (literal, a string literal in appTranslationDataShape; a string literal in pushFormViewCopy; a string literal in pushThankYouPanel))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-6.mdx`  _(via translatePage (symbol, a top-level function))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-7.mdx`  _(via submitBehavior (literal, a string literal in appTranslationDataShape; a string literal in pushFormViewCopy; a string literal in pushThankYouPanel))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/index.mdx`  _(via submitBehavior (literal, a string literal in appTranslationDataShape; a string literal in pushFormViewCopy; a string literal in pushThankYouPanel))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/system.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/system.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- the SDK route bridge reached **59** of **211** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **177** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 744ad0ad3afbc29fd0bfee9e8a8e3b7ac3958aec` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `7568d8d800088a108e66d97181e60ebca3e091cb` — the merge of head `8837fd001625eb762b195ac503cac896a3edd6b8` into base `744ad0ad3afbc29fd0bfee9e8a8e3b7ac3958aec`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 7568d8d800088a108e66d97181e60ebca3e091cb && git checkout 7568d8d800088a108e66d97181e60ebca3e091cb
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 744ad0ad3afbc29fd0bfee9e8a8e3b7ac3958aec 8837fd001625eb762b195ac503cac896a3edd6b8 && git checkout -B drift-repro 744ad0ad3afbc29fd0bfee9e8a8e3b7ac3958aec && git merge --no-ff 8837fd001625eb762b195ac503cac896a3edd6b8

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 744ad0ad3afbc29fd0bfee9e8a8e3b7ac3958aec
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 744ad0ad3afbc29fd0bfee9e8a8e3b7ac3958aec` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `8837fd001625eb762b195ac503cac896a3edd6b8`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts (`submitBehaviorTranslationSchema` factory, the `pages.PAGE.components.ID.submitBehavior` member, the `thankYou` alias), packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts (`translateFormSubmitBehavior` taking a lookup, `PAGE_FORM_COMPONENT_TYPE`, `lookupPageFormSubmitBehaviorText`, the `translatePage` branch) + packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.page-form-thank-you.test.ts, packages/spec/api-surface/system.json and export-origins/system.json (the new export), packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts and its test (the `components.ID.submitBehavior` target check), packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts (`pushThankYouPanel`) and its coverage test, examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/new-project-wizard.page.ts (the form id) and src/system/translations/index.ts (zh-CN copy), .changeset/28214-page-form-thank-you-translation.md, content/docs/ui/translations.mdx

Inputs: card #28214 (body, triage 6530114050 and 6531357708, claim 6532865741, claim correction 6534307642 adding the showcase page id to the file surface, os-dev-report 6534288052), the S1 should-fix of record 6528389425 on #28195 that filed it, the PR body, the diff of 9e7da93f against merge base 0027c4a2 and the one docs-only commit 8837fd00 on top of it (two key-table rows in content/docs/ui/translations.mdx, the form view's panel key and the page form's panel key, nothing else), the head's check-runs (read 2026-10-30T22:34Z: check-runs on 8837fd001625eb762b195ac503cac896a3edd6b8: 50 total, 41 success (Auto Label, Build & E2E UI, Build Core, Build Docs, Build UI Deps, Check Changeset, Check Documentation Links, Check PR Size, Dogfood Regression Gate, Flag docs affected by code changes, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Lint & Repo Gates, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Live E2E UI, PR-body guards (claim · duplicate · Part-of · single-writer path), Plan Test Core shards, Spec property liveness, Test Core, Test Core (all 8), Test UI, Type Check UI, Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · debt ledger, Type Check · source gates, Type Check · workspace, TypeScript Type Check, filter); 9 skipped path-filtered (18.x upgrade harness (opt-in), Dogfood Regression Gate (matrix shard/3), Dogfood Verify CLI, Lint UI, Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in), Schedule gate · skip when a green push run covers the commit, Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL), Test UI (matrix shard/16), UI Published Artifacts); 0 failure, 0 in progress). Author `user.login` is objectstack-fleet[bot]; the drafter is session_01L9qibyMTiYRPdRNbNBCGdF on `claude/project-thread-8iwnj7`; the reviewer is not the drafter.

### ① Derived judgments

- The key: `pages.PAGE.components.ID.submitBehavior: { title?, message? }` is a strict node built by the new `submitBehaviorTranslationSchema(surface)` factory, which the form view's `_views.VIEW.submitBehavior` now mounts too, so both addresses carry one alias table (`heading`, `text`, `body`, `description`) and the same `url` / `kind` prescriptions; the components node gains `thankYou: 'submitBehavior'` as the `_views` node has. The `actionTranslationSchema` precedent in the same file; no second copy of the shape.
- The overlay: `translateFormSubmitBehavior` now takes a `lookup(attr)` and is the one comparison for both carriers; `translateView` passes the `_views` lookup it used before (behaviour unchanged, the `viewKey` hoisted once), `translatePage` passes `lookupPageFormSubmitBehaviorText` for an addressed component of type `PAGE_FORM_COMPONENT_TYPE` (`'object-form'`), on the same `addressed` arbitration as the component's `title` / `description`, before the `nested` early return, so a nested form is reached by the id route. Rules therefore hold at both carriers: only a `kind: 'thank-you'` panel, only an authored non-empty string, missing key keeps the authored text, identity returned when nothing applies, document not mutated. Matches the card's "same override rules, one comparison" ask.
- Route (a), under the page, with the alternative (b, under the bound object) named and refused for the reason the card asked to see: the panel is the page's copy, two pages binding one object may word it differently, and the id route is the one extractor, lint and resolver already share; the cost (a form without an `id` has no key) is the rule every page component follows, and the showcase form gets an id for it.
- Extractor and lint follow: `pushThankYouPanel` holds the thank-you reading once for both carriers (a non-thank-you kind records both keys unauthored, as before on the view side); lint refuses a `submitBehavior` key under a component the page declares with another type or under an undeclared id, offering the nearest `object-form` id, and skips an undeclared page as the tab-items check does.
- Tests match the claims: 12 spec cases through parsed fixtures (`PageSchema`, `TranslationDataSchema`) and `translateMetadataDocument('page', …)`: translation, fallback chain, missing key, no-message control, redirect control, wrong-id and non-form controls, title-key and panel-key separation, no-id control, non-mutation, and the face's two refusals; lint and extractor tests beside them.

### ② Semver level

`@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/lint`: all `minor`, with `Clause-②: yes` and `Metadata-protocol: added` on body and changeset. One optional translation node joins a published schema and one constant is exported: a widening, nothing an author wrote before changes meaning or is refused; `added` requires at least one moved package at minor, and all three carriers agree (body, claim 6532865741 with its correction, changeset). Skills-docs follow-up #28215 named.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The console reads `submitBehavior` from the component props (`ObjectForm.tsx`, `WizardForm.tsx`) and `/meta/page` goes through `translateMetadataDocument`, so the translated panel reaches the reader with no ui change. The body says this is a code reading, not a live measure; acceptable for a spec-half card whose renderer is unchanged.
- File surface: all paths are inside the order's list plus the seat's correction 6534307642 (the showcase page id) and the two `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx` rows the seat approved in its lane note (commit 8837fd00). The PR body still names 9e7da93f; the seat patches it at ACCEPT.
- Should-fix, not blocking: the generated translation reference renders the page `components` node collapsed, so the new key is documented in the `translations.mdx` key table (8837fd00) but not in the generated reference; worth a row there when that generator next expands page nodes.

### ④ Design judgment

Against the card's scenario (the showcase wizard's "Project created" panel staying English in every locale) the change holds: the id gives the form an address, the zh-CN pack carries the four strings, and the resolver overlays them by the form view's rules. Against the spec on main, the factory removes the only path by which the two panel addresses could drift, and the exported constant makes resolver, extractor and lint agree on which component carries the key, the `PAGE_TABS_COMPONENT_TYPE` precedent. The route choice is argued on ownership of the copy, which is the right axis.

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 页面里 `object-form` 组件的“提交成功”面板（标题、正文）现在可以翻译了，键位是 `pages.页面.components.组件ID.submitBehavior.title / .message`。表单视图的同类键 `_views.视图.submitBehavior` 和它共用一个形状和一套覆盖规则。抽取器会生成这些键，lint 会校验它们，示例应用的新建项目向导也补上了中文。
- **为什么改：** #28214。#28195 只让表单视图的面板可以翻译，嵌在页面里的表单面板在所有语言下仍然显示作者写的原文。
- **风险与回滚：** 只是新增一个可选的翻译节点，已有的翻译包和页面含义都不变。渲染端没有改动。没有 id 的组件不会有键。回滚即 revert。
- **先看：** `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`（`translateFormSubmitBehavior` 改为接收查找函数，`translatePage` 新增的分支）和 `translation.zod.ts` 的共用工厂。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/system/i18n-resolver.page-form-thank-you.test.ts`。
- **需要你做的：** 无。不属于受管面，契约复审 PASS（评论 6534935725），由席位落地。
- **席位意见：** ACCEPT，可落地。

Head `8837fd001625eb762b195ac503cac896a3edd6b8`. Card #28214: claim 6532865741, correction 6534307642, os-dev-report 6534288052. The maintainer's ruling, verbatim: 「按 pm-dispatch 审过的pr你可以自主落地」.
